## Validation

- [ ] Regression tests protect the change.
- [ ] `npm run lint` passes.
- [ ] `npm run format:check` passes.
- [ ] `npm run typecheck` and `npm run build` pass.
- [ ] `npm run test:cov` passes; line/branch coverage is recorded.
- [ ] Public behavior and transaction boundaries are preserved.
- [ ] Relevant documentation and CHANGELOG are updated.
- [ ] Another teammate has left a substantive comment classified as blocking or non-blocking.
- [ ] Review discussions are resolved and at least one teammate has approved.
